population: every `crontab -l` job line with a fixed minute field whose expansion fires inside 05:30–08:00 or 16:00–18:40 (233 lines), plus the 18 Hermes learning/overnight chain lines (window=HERMES)

sources.safe_flock: CURRENT/logs/safe_flock_events.jsonl started→completed pair for the step lock (VERIFIED)
sources.pipeline_runs: Postgres pipeline_runs heartbeat row (started_at, finished_at) written by the script or its run_scheduled_* wrapper; read-only SELECT (VERIFIED)
sources.log_end: the line's own log: timestamped start inside the fire slot and an explicit end marker (Finished/Complete/Done/…) (VERIFIED)
sources.log_duration: the line's own log prints duration_s/elapsed (VERIFIED)
sources.pam_exact: syslog CRON CMD start + /var/log/auth.log pam_unix(cron:session) close, unambiguous because only one johnclaw cron session opened in that minute or every other session was explained by its own verified duration or by its `timeout N` kill (VERIFIED)
sources.pam_timeout_kill: the PAM session length equals the line's own `timeout N` (±3 s): the job ran to its timeout (VERIFIED duration, FAILED completion)
sources.log_span: own log: first..last timestamped line, no end marker — a LOWER BOUND (NOT VERIFIED)
sources.pam_group_max: several johnclaw cron sessions opened that minute; the longest unexplained session is an UPPER BOUND for this line (NOT VERIFIED; attribution ambiguous)
sources.syslog_only: only the CRON start exists (NOT VERIFIED)

rejected_sources: log/receipt last-write mtime pairing (not acceptable per the brief); syslog has no CMDEND lines on this host; process accounting (lastcomm) is not installed
